english.note: Use this for the sage herb or its dried seasoning; it does not mean a wise person.

examples.english: I add a little sage when I make chicken soup, and the aroma comes right out.
examples.traditional: 我煮雞湯嗰陣加少少鼠尾草，香味即刻出晒嚟。
